annotations.title: Get WA data library features near a point

description: Use to see what one WA data library layer (a "lib:..." id from search_wa_data_library) holds around a point, e.g. the bedrock units, dykes, heritage places or WAROX observations around a prospect. Returns the features within the radius, sorted by distance, nearest first, each with its fields, label, distance and a point on it.
name: get_wa_library_features
title: Get WA data library features near a point
